# `aitbc edge metrics delete-metric`

Delete an edge metric by its ID.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc edge metrics delete-metric [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--metric-id` | text | — | yes | The Metric id. |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc edge metrics delete-metric --metric-id <metric_id>
```
